checks.rationale: Both TASK-006-AC1/AC2 are supported: real fixed-argv execution, all cwd bindings, exit/timestamp evidence, bounded durable redacted logs, launch failure, timeout and cancellation. The Windows declared suite and Linux minimum-version phases passed.

The task implements observed process evidence under frozen local ports and configuration. It leaves success-rule interpretation, runtime wiring, providers, remote effects and shared records to their owners; REQ-02/09 and task exclusions are respected.

Traced execute through preflight, unchanged argv/Popen shell=False, captured process/group identity, parent-and-reader completion monitoring, shared capture budget, bounded drain settlement and immutable evidence. The a3 correction changes only the inherited-cancellation oracle.

Launch, cancellation, unconfirmed tree containment, backward clock and unavailable storage retain explicit non-success evidence. All eight independently executed native fixture subcases settled exact parent/child identities and readers without watchdog intervention; a second-log-write failure preserves only the genuinely stored reference.

Zero-plan requests, whitespace-significant/repeated argv, missing/escaped cwd bindings, deny-all permissions, sandbox/platform refusal, empty/NUL environment, combined output limits, cross-read secrets and identity reuse are covered. Independent UTF-8/UTF-16LE/UTF-16BE capture and negative readiness controls passed.

The 22-test leaf exercises real processes; the four bound coordinator suites retain 21 non-skipped tests and one established skip each. Linux3.11 independently reached all four final schema checks after phase/status/EOF assertions. Expected negative probes prove absent phase, expired startup and watchdog-assisted completion cannot manufacture a pass.

The full 119896-byte raw base-to-head diff has only the three declared paths. Frozen production and the exact 2100-byte a2-to-a3 test patch match the terminal decision, preserving helpers, watchdog, detached test, other assertions and time bounds.

Git reconstructs only additions of commands.py, its isolated test leaf and its handoff. Other production, accepted dependency handoffs, schemas, plan/spec/ADRs, graph, policy and model configuration are unchanged relative to the frozen base/context.

The flat typed module implements CommandRunner.execute(CommandRequest)->CommandEvidence with explicit injected clock/IDs, cancellation, log storage and tree-termination collaborators. It consumes accepted 002/004/038 values directly and adds no shared DTO, schema or central export.

Reviewed explicit permission admission, unsupported sandbox refusal, contained cwd/log paths, shell=False plus Windows batch refusal, allowlisted request environment without ambient copying, sensitive argv/output redaction and conservative native cleanup claims. Real refusal/redaction tests and independent multi-encoding capture pass; worktree scope is not represented as a sandbox.

The owned handoff accurately distinguishes a1/a2 failures, a3's one assertion correction, malformed diagnostic setup, actual current validation, platform cleanup/EOF limits and the next fresh R2 gate. Retained historical passes remain historical. This review separately preserves its path-parser setup error and coordinator acknowledgement without relabeling either as candidate behavior.
